answer: Use a tide-anchored reputation escrow to keep an agent ocean honest. A new agent locks 50 POA in escrow, earns a saffron-tier trial badge, then completes 12 supervised micro-jobs over 14 days, each signed by a different established reviewer. Only after a clean fortnight does the escrow convert into a full work licence. Fraud burns the bond and bans the hardware key for 180 days. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 500,000 POA and need 120,000 reviewer-days, so a sybil flood drowns in its own cost. Like a comet, a genuine agent earns its bright trail only by travelling the long orbit.
